extension_rule: Add a new name here in a reviewed commit with a one-sentence definition. Names are checked for membership only; a renamed copy of an existing picture is still refused by the structural fingerprints and the three-dimension rule in art_gate.py.

style_families.architectural_elevation: flat front elevation of built or unbuilt structures with frame, pillar and tab
style_families.isometric_cutaway: isometric projection of a solid with cut faces and shadowed planes
style_families.halftone_duotone: two-ink dot screen whose density carries the form
style_families.blueprint_linework: ink and paper plan drawings on a dark panel
style_families.paper_cut_relief: layered cut paper with shadow between layers
style_families.stratigraphic_section: horizontal bands of material cut in section
style_families.lightbox_sculpture: backlit translucent forms with glowing edges
style_families.woodcut_relief: carved black-and-ink shapes with hatched texture
style_families.enamel_still_life: lit enamel and brass objects arranged as a still life
style_families.gouache_flat: matte opaque color fields with soft edges
style_families.stipple_engraving: dot and line engraving built from fine marks
style_families.collage_torn_paper: torn-edge paper pieces over a ground
style_families.woven_tapestry: interlocking colored threads whose crossings define recognizable objects
style_families.stained_glass: faceted translucent panes separated by dark structural seams
style_families.screenprint_silhouette: bold layered silhouettes with deliberate negative space and ink texture
style_families.embossed_metal: raised and recessed metal forms modeled with opposing edge highlights

compositions.horizon_split: a single horizon line dividing ground from sky
compositions.vertical_tower_diagonal_split: a tall mass set against a diagonal division
compositions.low_angle_monolith: one dominant mass seen from below
compositions.still_life_cluster: several objects arranged around a shared base
compositions.bridge_across_gap: two anchors with a span between them
compositions.frieze_horizontal: a long horizontal band of linked figures
compositions.scatter_field: irregular objects distributed across the field
compositions.inset_cutaway: a circular or rectangular cut revealing interior parts
compositions.exploded_assembly: separated parts along a shared axis revealing how an object works
compositions.nested_thresholds: successive doorways or frames reveal an action at the deepest opening
compositions.off_center_counterweight: two unequal masses balance around an off-center pivot
compositions.overhead_workbench: recognizable tools and work pieces arranged in a top-down working scene
compositions.spiral_progression: forms wind around an open center with a clear beginning and end

materials.matte_lacquer: matte painted surfaces with soft sheen

light_models.lamp_on_table: a single lamp over a table
light_models.window_side_light: daylight from one side of a room
